items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: But I remember Pete Marville and P. Ron, they was on the boat. Yeah. They were wonderful musicians too.

ctx.x: I met him there two years ago. Did you ever play on the boat with him? I remember he told us he used to work on the boat. I never did. I never did work the boat.

When I joined the band, it was after they left the boat. Yeah. But I remember Pete Marville and P. Ron, they was on the boat. Yeah. They were wonderful musicians too. Yeah. But Sidney, when I joined Sidney's outfit, they had left the boat. I enjoyed it.

I enjoyed it. Um, can you tell me, did you ever learn to read by yourself? Or did you, when you joined his band, did they have the drum parts too? Of course, the drummer doesn't have to read as much music as the other people. I just wondered.
